# Design tokens

<!-- Generated by scripts/tokens-doc.py. Edit tokens.css, then run: npm run tokens-doc -->

All values live in [`src/design-tokens/tokens.css`](../src/design-tokens/tokens.css). This page is a readable summary. For swatches, type samples and live contrast checks, open [`tokens.html`](tokens.html) in a browser: it reads `tokens.css` directly, so it never goes stale.

## Rules

- Use tokens, never raw values.
- **Colour:** components use the `--color-*` roles. Palette names are for brand decoration only (gold rules, burgundy accents).
- **Headings** get `--font-display` globally; components set size and weight only.
- **Running text** is capped at `--measure`. Centred blocks use the `centered` mixin.
- **Spacing:** use the roles. `--gap-related` between things that belong together, `--gap-items` between items in a group, `--gap-groups` between groups; `--inset-*` for padding. A container's padding is at least its largest inner gap, and equal on all sides unless there's a reason.
- **Dark sections** include the `on-dark` mixin, which switches `--color-accent` and `--color-focus` to gold.

## Colour

### Palette

Contrast is the WCAG ratio against parchment and navy. Body text needs 4.5, large text 3.0.

### Roles

| Token | Value | Note | On parchment | On navy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--color-bg` | `var(--parchment)` | | 1.0 | 13.9 |
| `--color-surface` | `var(--ivory)` | cards, inputs, raised panels | 1.1 | 15.4 |
| `--color-surface-dark` | `var(--navy)` | dark sections, solid buttons | 13.9 | 1.0 |
| `--color-surface-dark-hover` | `var(--navy-light)` | | 11.7 | 1.2 |
| `--color-surface-deep` | `var(--ink)` | footer | 15.4 | 1.1 |
| `--color-text` | `var(--charcoal)` | 12.1:1 | 12.1 | 1.1 |
| `--color-text-secondary` | `var(--stone)` | 5.5:1 | 5.5 | 2.5 |
| `--color-text-strong` | `var(--navy)` | headings, titles, emphasised UI text. 13.9:1 | 13.9 | 1.0 |
| `--color-border` | `var(--parchment-dark)` | decorative rules only, 1.2:1 | 1.2 | 12.0 |
| `--color-border-strong` | `var(--stone)` | edges of inputs and controls, needs 3:1 | 5.5 | 2.5 |
| `--color-accent` | `var(--gold-dark)` | links, eyebrows, rules. 5.4:1 | 5.4 | 2.6 |
| `--color-focus` | `var(--navy)` | | 13.9 | 1.0 |

| `--color-text-on-dark-secondary` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ivory) 85%, transparent)` | | – | – |
| `--color-text-on-dark-muted` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ivory) 70%, transparent)` | | – | – |

## Spacing

### Roles (use these)

| Token | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `--gap-related` | `var(--space-2)` | 8px: a label and its control, a title and its meta line |
| `--gap-items` | `var(--space-4)` | 16px: items in one group, e.g. form fields, list rows |
| `--gap-groups` | `var(--space-6)` | 32px: distinct groups inside one component |
| `--inset-sm` | `var(--space-3)` | 12px: chips, small buttons, table cells |
| `--inset-md` | `var(--space-4)` | 16px: cards, callouts, list items |
| `--inset-lg` | `var(--space-5)` | 24px: dialogs, panels, large cards |
